1.D. □□□ □ 7.16 TRANSLATION OF A LETTER FROM CHANG
TSO LIN TO THE PRESIDENT.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

June 27th 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE DETECTIVE BRANCH）

SIR,
It is reported that the Navy and the Kuomintang party
in Shanghai are working in unison. Several telegrams
have been sent to Li Yuen Hung demanding the
restoration of the Provisional constitution and the
punishment of the monarchical plotters.
With reference to the arrest of a city shopkeeper
named Li Dah Foo for having bombs in his house
which he alleged were sent to him in two baskets of straw
berries several merchants in the City have petitioned
Military Governor Yang saying that the charge is false and
that the evidence has been fabricated by detectives.
In consequence of this petition General Yang has decided
to try the case himself.
It is reported that a fifth of the Arsenal employees
who are not soldiers will be dismissed from 1st prox.
One hundred recruits for the local police arrived
here to-day from the North.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
上海工部局。

1916年6月27日。

（印：上海工部局警务处侦探股）

先生，
据报，上海的海军与国民党正协同行动。已向黎元洪发送数封电报，要求恢复《临时约法》并惩办帝制阴谋分子。
关于一名名为李达甫（Li Dah Foo）的城内店主因家中藏有炸弹而被捕一事，他声称这些炸弹是夹在两篮草莓中寄给他的，城内数名商人已向杨督军请愿，称该项指控不实，证据系侦探伪造。
鉴于此请愿，杨将军决定亲自审理此案。
据报，兵工厂非军人雇员中的五分之一将于下月1日起被解雇。
一百名本地警察新兵今日从北方抵达此处。

您顺从的仆人，

首席侦探督察。
警务处总巡官。

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：POLICE FORCE. DETECTIVE BRANCH）

June 27th 1916.

Sir,

The declaration issued by the Commanders of the
Chinese men-of-war, appears to be due to a determination
to get rid of Liu Kuei Yang 劉桂陽 who was a supporter
of the monarchical movement and who did many things
which were displeasing to the parties of the South.

He also was instrumental in bringing about the
removal of Admiral Lee Ting Sun 李鼎新 on account of
the Chashu incident and Admiral Lee who since the
death of Yuan Shih Kai has been restored to his former
post is now endeavouring to bring about the dismissal
of Liu who has a bad reputation and who as a Minister
is most incompetent.

Your obedient servant,

[Signature]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
上海工部局。

（印：警务处。侦探股）

1916年6月27日。

先生，

中国军舰司令们发表的宣言，似乎是由于决心除掉刘桂阳（Liu Kuei Yang），此人是帝制运动的支持者，且做了许多令南方各派不满之事。

他还曾促成因查树（Chashu）事件而罢免李鼎新（Lee Ting Sun）海军上将，而李上将自袁世凯死后已复职，现正努力促使罢免名声不佳且作为部长极不称职的刘某。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

首席侦探督察。
警务处总巡官。
